def third_largest_distinct(nums):
    """Return the third largest value among the DISTINCT values of nums (duplicates count once). If nums has fewer than 3 distinct values, return None.
    >>> third_largest_distinct([-1, -1, 0, 3, 3])
    -1
    >>> third_largest_distinct([-20, 23, 37, -36, 50, 46, -39, 6, -49, -31, 4])
    37
    >>> third_largest_distinct([])
    """
